title: 火山eruption forecast的可靠決策
statement: 將多sensor precursor轉為校準eruption probability，並把forecast skill與false-alarm/catastrophic-loss decision value分開。
known_result: 2026 Nature Communications研究直接比較data-driven eruption forecasts在不同false alarm與loss下的societal value。
open_gap: cross-volcano transfer、nonstationary precursors、rare eruption labels與utility assumptions。
first_task: 用synthetic event stream重現accuracy相同但decision value不同的兩個forecast；再做公開volcano資料小回測。
evaluator: calibration、lead time、false alarms、expected loss under frozen utility。
validation_limits: utility不是物理truth；不同community成本不能私自假設。
completion_criterion: forecast probability跨volcano/time保持校準，decision layer另以透明utility評估。
screening_note: 2026-09-28 初始有界文獻篩查；每輪需重查最新資料、修訂與事件。OPEN不代表全網無解。

sources.title: Socio-economic value of data-driven eruption forecasts to balance false alarms against catastrophic loss
sources.supports: eruption forecast skill與decision value的區分
